question: Should `isReplySessionInitConflictError` become a supported public Plugin SDK API whose stable semantics include legacy-message matching and traversal of `cause` and `.error` wrappers?
rationale: This is a new permanent external API and changes channel delivery handling; the repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for plugin API additions rather than treating the choice as a mechanical refactor.

options.title: Accept a narrow public classifier
options.body: Approve this SDK export with documented exact-match and wrapper-traversal semantics, after refreshed current-head Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep the classifier internal
options.body: Retain one shared core helper for bundled channels but do not expose it through the external Plugin SDK until a broader plugin contract is designed.

options.title: Defer API direction
options.body: Pause this PR and settle the Plugin SDK error-classification contract alongside the related QQBot delivery work.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow public classifier
recommendation.body: Approve this SDK export with documented exact-match and wrapper-traversal semantics, after refreshed current-head Telegram proof.
